# Unique relationship edge

Relationship edges are unique per repository: (repo_id, from_entity_id, relation_type, to_entity_id) is enforced by the UniqueConstraint 'uq_relationships_edge'.

Avoid storing duplicate edges in the repository's relationship graph.

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.RelationshipRow`
